entries.zh: 苦：苦苦恳求、哀告（苦求之义）；苦，痛苦、苦况
entries.en: to beg earnestly, to entreat bitterly; bitter, suffering

entries.zh: 苦訴：苦苦哀求、哭诉恳求
entries.en: to plead or implore bitterly; bitter complaint/entreaty
entries.notes: 音写第二形 ziu 未能确解（或为另一读法），主释义由汉字苦訴、音写 cou sou 与西语 suplicar encarecidamente 互证。

entries.zh: 揖讓：作揖谦让、拱手行礼让敬（揖请恳求时的客套礼节）
entries.en: to bow with clasped hands in courteous salute; to yield politely (in polite entreaty)
entries.notes: L 栏标 [疑:al m./a vm.] 两读未定，释义取揖让本义。

entries.zh: 求情：恳求、说情（代人讨情求饶）
entries.en: to plead, to intercede; to ask for favor or mercy

entries.zh: 累算：累计核算、累加补算（补足亏缺之数）
entries.en: to reckon up cumulatively, to sum accounts; to make up what is lacking (Spanish example passage garbled)
entries.notes: 西语例句残损（pagte./Sta. Mte./dos fi tuir 难辨），释义以汉字累算与音写 lui gui 为据。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语与汉字两栏俱空，仅存音写且第二词被删划、声调号污损（T99），无从释义。

entries.zh: 南：南方；南（星宿义，见下条南斗星）
entries.en: south; (star, as in the Southern Dipper compound)
entries.notes: L 栏 m. S wr. 难辨（或为 sur 之缩写），释义由汉字南、音写 lam 与西语 estrella 互证。

entries.zh: 南斗星：南斗（六星星宿名），与北斗相对
entries.en: the Southern Dipper constellation (Nan-tou star)

entries.zh: 氣：气、气息；叹气出气（suspirar 之译）
entries.en: breath, vital air; to sigh, to breathe out
entries.notes: 音写 gui: cui. 之第二形未确解，主释义由汉字氣与西语 suspirar 互证。

entries.zh: 吐：吐出、呼出（如吐气）；呕吐
entries.en: to spit out, to exhale/emit; to vomit

entries.zh: 嘆：叹气、叹息
entries.en: to sigh, to lament

entries.zh: 嗟：嗟叹，哀叹感慨
entries.en: to sigh (alas!), to lament

entries.zh: 吐氣：呼气出气，含怨叹气（带抱怨之态）
entries.en: to breathe out, to sigh while complaining or murmuring (quejándose)
entries.notes: L 栏标 [疑:quexandose/quexandoce]，第三音写 gefandose 亦依赖推断。

entries.zh: 嗆嘆：叹息，同嗟叹之义（嗆音同嗟）
entries.en: to sigh, to lament

entries.zh: 嘆息：叹息，叹气
entries.en: to sigh, a sigh

entries.zh: 嘆氣：叹气
entries.en: to sigh

entries.zh: 嘆恨：叹恨，遗恨不平而叹息
entries.en: to sigh with regret or resentment

entries.zh: 嘆算：叹息（嘆字明确；算字于此义难确指）
entries.en: to sigh (role of second character uncertain in this compound)
entries.notes: 嘆算非习见复合词，第二字算之作用未能定夺，主义取嘆、音写 fan 与西语 suspirar。

entries.zh: 嘆聲：叹息之声，哀叹声
entries.en: a sigh, the sound of pained sighing

entries.zh: 養：养育、抚养；供养养活
entries.en: to nourish, to rear/raise; to sustain, to provide for
entries.notes: 本条声调号污损（T99）按规程归低；西语 sustentar/criar、汉字養与音写 iang 互证，释义本身明确。
